verdict.rationale: A hosted cloud tier is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, since products of this kind can offer one, so the axis applies. llamafile's documentation describes it as purely local ('No cloud, no data sharing') and never mentions a hosted tier, pricing, rate limits or usage caps. The verdict is therefore none, not na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the pricing tiers, rate limits, and usage caps that apply when offloading inference to the vendor's hosted cloud tier
